rules.reason: Installer authoring requirements are delivered before manifest generation or validation.
rules.summary: Author deterministic setup manifests with script-first steps, shared libraries, clear verification, logical units, and recovery procedures.

rules.reason: Installer safety applies to setup authoring and execution entry points.
rules.summary: Validate setup manifests and collect parameters before execution; show planned steps, confirm destructive actions, and keep secrets out of manifests and scripts.

rules.reason: Browser-specific safety is available before browser driver and lifecycle operations.
rules.summary: Authorize browser origins and sensitive actions, protect tokens and storage, log sanitized activity, and clean up browser subprocesses.

rules.reason: BLOCK civic restrictions govern every indexed civic workflow and role before acquisition or action.
rules.summary: Fail closed on unresolved civic access or consent; prohibit covert recording, bypass, targeting, threats, and impersonation; minimize personal data.

rules.reason: BLOCK publication gates are delivered to all civic workflows and roles before external actions.
rules.summary: Require an independent named human to approve the exact artifact hash before civic publication or external action; retain the review record and blocking findings.

rules.reason: BLOCK claim integrity applies to civic evidence processing and publication across all civic artifacts.
rules.summary: Link each material civic claim to a source and selector, separate evidence dimensions, preserve uncertainty, and append corrections without rewriting history.

rules.reason: Color presentation details belong to palette generation, trends, and accessibility work.
rules.summary: Display colors with lowercase six-digit HEX, swatches, and descriptive names; order palettes consistently and label contrast ratios and accessibility results.

rules.reason: A startup relevance reminder precedes context selection; detailed classification binds to the curator.
rules.summary: Classify context against the task time, entity, and operation scope; use relevant sections first and exclude distractors.

rules.reason: A startup scope reminder constrains initial reasoning; detailed recovery binds to the curator.
rules.summary: Keep reasoning and output within the stated task boundaries; remove off-scope material and obtain scope clarification before expanding work.

rules.reason: Daemon interaction policy is role-specific and explicitly excludes ordinary interactive sessions.
rules.summary: Use concise concierge responses in daemon sessions, absorb technical errors, honor remembered constraints, and confirm destructive operations.

rules.reason: Preserve existing dataset path coverage and bind every dataset workflow and review role.
rules.summary: Delegate dataset execution to the shared service; require digest-scoped approval, protect credentials, distinguish canonical and derived data, and preserve checkpoints.

rules.reason: BLOCK capture and disclosure safety is scoped to the indexed network-capture analysis skill.
rules.summary: Require bounded capture authority and separate disclosure approval; analyze immutable captures with trusted isolated tools and exclude secrets and payloads by default.

rules.reason: Prose integration and contract mapping are needed only when choosing or running Prose.
rules.summary: Use Prose only for suitable declarative contracts; map inputs and outputs explicitly, select a capable model, and preserve formal outputs in AIWG artifact paths.

rules.reason: Every Prose entry point can load the resolution protocol before operating.
rules.summary: Resolve PROSE_ROOT through prose-detect before Prose work, validate both specification files, revalidate cached paths, and obtain approval before installation.

rules.reason: The ADR scopes RLM details to recursive-context skills and the RLM agent.
rules.summary: Filter and read large context selectively; bound recursive calls by budget and concurrency caps, reconcile findings, and checkpoint long-running RLM work.

rules.reason: The ADR selects paths; retain existing data-contract globs and bind schema authoring and review.
rules.summary: Define governed schemas for persistent or exchanged structured data; record authority, ownership, compatibility, fixtures, and projection evidence or a reviewed opt-out.

rules.reason: The ADR binds detailed evidence requirements to conformance audits, normalization, and platform research.
rules.summary: Separate test evidence units, require current source and runner evidence, preserve unknown and failing states, and verify negative controls without weakening tests.

rules.reason: The ADR scopes factor evidence to Twelve-Factor design, audits, and their reviewer.
rules.summary: Tie every factor finding to reproducible evidence or mark it missing; use explicit statuses, attach remediation to gaps, and separate observations from recommendations.

rules.reason: A startup reminder detects variety needs before skill selection; detailed tuning binds to the unambiguous diversity-tuning skill.
rules.summary: Consider Verbalized Sampling for requested alternatives or creative variety; honor autoApply preferences and avoid it for single-answer or speed-focused tasks.

rules.reason: Preserve existing writing-path triggers and bind voice selection, analysis, and application.
rules.summary: Apply the audience-appropriate voice using project, user, then built-in profile precedence; write precisely with concrete examples and varied structure.
